description.value: The Griz Inn is a ski-in/ski-out hotel and condominium complex situated at the base of Fernie Alpine Resort, originally built in 1983 and a fixture of the resort for over 30 years. It offers a range of fully-equipped accommodations from hotel rooms to 3-bedroom loft suites, all with full kitchens and mountain views. The on-site Rusty Edge Restaurant and All In Skier Services boot-fitting and ski shop are located within the building.

address.value: 5369 Fernie Ski Hill Road, Fernie, BC
